notes.title: Cockhead is now available
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and thank you very much for waiting.

We are pleased to announce that [b]Cockhead is now available[/b].

We apologize to everyone who waiting Cockhead and for the 2 month delay. 
We tried to release the game as soon as possible, but we must to spend these 2 months for additional testing and bug fixes.

We would like to remind you that Cockhead released in Early Access, so it does not exclude the possibility of errors, which we undertake to regularly fix and release new updates.

Thank you for your patience

P.S. Cockhead Big Kahuna Bar will be available during a few months.

[i]Yoba Games Team[/i]
